Government shared data centre rules with AI firm early

The Australian government provided an artificial intelligence company with an early look at proposed data centre regulations, according to reports. The company was given a "sneak peek" at the rules before they were made public. Details about the specific AI giant or the exact timing of this disclosure were not provided in the coverage.
